# Change record template

Copy this template for a major feature, phase checkpoint or release. Replace every field; an unfilled template is not evidence.

## Identity

- Product version before and after:
- Checkpoint/release name:
- Date:
- Phase and live tracker issue:
- Record type: local checkpoint / tested candidate / deployed Preview / production release.
- Exact revision, artifact hashes or pending local-change identity:
- Environment:

## Change

- Problem and resulting behavior:
- Delivered scope:
- Affected guides, reference and runbooks:
- Unaffected documentation areas and reason:
- Compatibility and migration implications:
- Security, privacy, content and document implications:

## Verification

| Check | Exact input/path/environment | Actual result | Limits |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Record checks actually run | Replace | Pass / fail / inconclusive / not-run | Replace |

Include required human review of the exact artifact when applicable. Never convert a missing check into a pass.

## Readiness and next step

- Known issues and remaining work:
- Required approvals and their recorded outcome:
- Rollback/recovery:
- Release/hold decision:
- One next action:

Keep participant data, credentials and internal authoring transcripts out of this record. Preserve required source/license attribution and artifact acceptance evidence.
